query: Screen sharing stopped working after upgrading to Electron 45 even though my setPermissionRequestHandler allows 'media'. Why?
goldAnswer: Electron 45 reports screen, window and tab capture requests to `setPermissionRequestHandler` as `display-capture` instead of `media`, so the handler must also allow `display-capture`.

query: Why does python -m ruff no longer work after updating Ruff to 0.17 from conda-forge?
goldAnswer: Ruff 0.17.0's conda-forge build no longer depends on Python, so `python -m ruff` and `import ruff` fail; run `ruff` from PATH instead.

query: Tailwind CSS v4 CLI --watch doesn't detect changes when filesystem events are unavailable. How do I fix it?
goldAnswer: Run `@tailwindcss/cli` with `--watch --poll` (optionally `--poll=<ms>`); polling support was added in Tailwind CSS v4.3.3.

query: In September 2026, ESA hailed what it called the first launch to orbit from continental Europe. In which town was the company that built that rocket headquartered?
goldAnswer: Ottobrunn, southeast of Munich, Germany (the rocket was Isar Aerospace's Spectrum).

query: My PostgREST jwt-role-claim-key of ".roles.read" stopped working after upgrading to v16.0. What's the new syntax?
goldAnswer: Prefix it with `$`, e.g. `$.roles.read` (PostgREST v16.0 switched `jwt-role-claim-key` from its JSPath DSL to RFC 9535 JSON Path; v16.2 accepts the old syntax again but deprecates it).

query: In October 2026 the CGPM fixed the date in 2027 from which UTC will be continuous, with no more leap seconds. Which annual UNESCO international day falls on that date?
goldAnswer: World Metrology Day (continuous UTC starts on 20 May 2027; 20 May marks the 1875 signing of the Metre Convention).

query: In its 'Trojan' rulings published in August 2025, Germany's Federal Constitutional Court held that using state trojan spyware (source telecommunications surveillance) in criminal investigations is unconstitutional for offences carrying a maximum prison sentence of how many years or less?
goldAnswer: 3 years [the court declared source telecommunications surveillance under the Code of Criminal Procedure void for offences carrying a maximum sentence of three years or less; orders of 24 June 2025, published 7 August 2025]

query: Under Portugal's legal safe harbour for good-faith security researchers (Article 8-A of the Cybercrime Law, added by a decree-law published in December 2025), within how many days of a reported vulnerability being fixed must the data handed to the system owner or the national cybersecurity authority be deleted?
goldAnswer: 10 days [counted from when the vulnerability is corrected; Article 8.º-A(4) of Lei n.º 109/2009, added by Decreto-Lei n.º 125/2025]
